Q. Q. 1 عَيْهَلْتُ الإِبلَِ I left the camels to pasture by themselves, without a pastor, by night and by day: mentioned by IB, on the authority of A'Obeyd: and he cites as an ex., “عَيْهَلَهَا الذُّوَّادُ ↓ عَيَاهِلُ
” [app. meaning Camels left to pasture by themselves, the drivers having left them to do so]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
